coordinator.note: claude-opus-4-8 differs from both annotators (claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5). The coordinator saw a1's hand-backs while collecting before some a2 batches completed, but a2 prompts are the fixed per-batch template and contain nothing from a1.

methodological_limitations: Both annotators are Claude models from one provider (Anthropic): D58 'different models' holds, but their errors may be correlated; agreement between them is NOT independent evidence and is NEVER human validation.
claude-haiku-5-5 (a2) is a smaller model than a1; more UNCERTAIN/INCORRECT labels and disagreements are expected (observed: a2 18 UNCERTAIN / 30 INCORRECT vs a1 11 / 24).
Sampling parameters are harness defaults and not recorded; re-running an annotator is not expected to reproduce labels byte-identically. The stored raw hand-backs are the record.

All 10 batches passed on attempt_1 with a single served model and only Read+SubagentHandback tool calls; no retries were needed and none were made. No safety-classifier interruption or model fallback occurred in any batch.
This is an AI post-filter review for a dataset audit; it does NOT adjudicate, produce PASS, set thresholds or authorize training. Coverage validation and the r4 adjudication with R3 are Codex's.
